en.answer: Even if your opponent Special Summons 2 or more monsters at the same time, such as by the effect of <<11159>>, the effect of <<11340>> can only activate once.
en.question: If my opponent activates Special Summons 2 monsters with the effect of <<11159>>, will the effect of my <<11340>> activate twice?
en.title: If my opponent activates Special Summons 2 monsters with the effect of <<11159>>, will the effect of my <<11340>> activate twice?

ja.answer: 「<<11159>>」のように、1つのカードの効果処理によって相手が複数体のモンスターを同時に特殊召喚した場合でも、「<<11340>>」の効果は1度のみ発動し処理を行います。
